senses.gloss: रूप- + मात्र रूप- + मात्र, n. only beauty, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 4.
† रुप् रुप्, i. 4, Par. To confound (cf. लुप्).

रूप् रूप्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from रूप), Par.
 1. To form, to represent in pantomime, Vikr. 6, 6; 12, 16; to notify by a gesture, Vikr. 47, 13.
 2. To feign, Vikr. 12, 17.
 --With the prep. नि नि,
 1. To perform, Man. 6, 38.
 2. To represent in pantomime, Śāk. 5, 16; Vikr. 29, 8.
 3. To look out, Vikr. 39, 5; to see, 78, 11; to perceive, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 10.
 4. To consider, to ponder, Hit. 10, 3.
 5. To investigate, Utt. Rāmac. 39, 18; to examine, Hit. 99, 1.
 6. To search, Hit. 68, 14.
 7. To select, Pañc. 161, 10.
 8. To appoint, [] 8, 24; 184, 8. निरूपित,
 1. Seen.
 2. Discovered.
 3. Considered, Bhāṣāp. 124.
 4. Ascertained, Bhāṣāp. 107.
 5. Resolved, Pañc. 158, 18.
 6. Appointed.
 --Comp.
 --With वि वि, To disfigure, Hit. 65, 1. विरूपित, Deformed, Man. 4, 67.

रूप रूप (probably from रूप्, an old form of रोप्, in रोपय, the Caus. of रुह्), n.
 1. Natural state or condition.
 2. State, Pañc. 137, 19.
 3. Form, Vikr. d. 9; figure, Chr. 17, 28; kind, Pañc. 21, 25.
 4. Appearance.
 5. An image.
 6. Beauty, Pañc. iii. d. 239.
 7. Colour, Bhāṣāp. 2. 99.
 8. A play, a dramatic poem.
 --Comp.

रूपक रूप + क, n.
 1. Shape.
 2. A drama.
 3. A kind of coin (cf. रूप्य), Pañc. 127, 8; 252, 13.
 --Comp.
रूपतस् रूप + तस्, adv. By shape, Nal. 19, 32.

रूपवन्त् रूप + वन्त्, adj., f. वति,
 1. Having shape.
 2. Beautiful, Pañc. i. d. 159, Chr.
 --Comp.

रूपिन् रूपिन्, i. e. रूप + इन्, adj., f. [] इणी,
 1. Having shape.
 2. Beautiful, Sāv. 1, 26.
 --Comp.
 When latter part of comp. words, रूप generally belongs to the former part, and the aff. इन् to the comp. word.

रूप्य रूप्य, i. e. रूप + य,
 I. adj. Handsome, Pāṇ. v. 2, 120.
 II. n.
 1. Silver, Man. 4, 230.
 2. Wrought silver, Pāṇ. ib.
 3. Wrought gold.
 --Comp.
ऽरूप्यक -रूप्य + क, in सुवर्ण-रूप्य + क, adj. Abounding in gold and silver, Rām. 4, 40, 33.
रूप्यमय रूप्य + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of silver, Pañc. 241, 16.
रूप- + संपत्ति रूप- + संपत्ति, f. beauty.
रूप-सेन रूप-सेन, m. a proper name, Lass. 19, 12.
